title: OpenAPI Imports
description: Imports are part of integration onboarding: pick a verified service connection, parse the endpoint list, then generate Tool drafts. The Tools page only receives drafts and completes the action contract.
needWorkspace: Create or join a Workspace first
emptyBody: Pick a verified service connection, import OpenAPI, then generate Tool drafts.
noMatchBody: Adjust file, source, or connection keywords
detailLoadFailed: Failed to load import detail. Retry.

importModalSubtitle: Confirm the Workspace, choose Provider and service connection, then parse the endpoint list
chooseJsonOrYaml: Select a JSON or YAML file
readyEndpointsHint: {n} endpoint(s) can generate Tool drafts; confirm each after import.

noProviderHint: Register a service in Provider management, then return to import OpenAPI.
